name: priomate
description: Read and manage your Priomate tasks, notes, drafts, inbox, time tracking and team projects from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
Priomate is a task manager for individuals and teams. With this plugin, ChatGPT can work with your Priomate workspace.

What it can do:
- Show an overview of what is due today and what is overdue, and search your tasks
- Create tasks, change them, add checklist items and mark tasks as done
- Manage color tags, notes and drafts
- Read your inbox and mark entries as read
- Start and stop the timer, add time entries and summarize tracked time
- Look up team projects, update project tasks, and read and post project chat messages

Limits:
- ChatGPT can read and write, but it cannot delete anything in Priomate.
- It only has access to your own workspace and the team projects you belong to.
- Changes are only made after you confirm them.

Requires a Priomate account. You sign in with that account when you connect the plugin.
capabilities: Manage notes, drafts and color tags
defaultPrompt: What is on my plate today?
Create a task to send the invoice by Friday
How much time did I track this week?

positive.description: Overview of overdue and open tasks
positive.prompt: Which of my tasks are overdue?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls tasks_overview and lists the overdue tasks (for example Pay office rent, Review marketing budget, Quarterly report). Makes no changes.

positive.description: Search for a task by keyword
positive.prompt: Find my tasks about the quarterly report.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls tasks_search with the keyword and lists the matching tasks with title, due date and status. If nothing matches, says so.

positive.prompt: Create a task 'Prepare tax documents' due next Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms title and due date with the user, then calls tasks_create and reports the created task. The task appears in Priomate.

positive.prompt: Mark my task 'Pay office rent' as done.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds 'Pay office rent' with tasks_search, asks for confirmation, then calls tasks_set_done and confirms the task is now completed.

positive.prompt: On which tasks did I track the most time, and which team projects do I have?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls time_totals and projects_list and answers with the tasks that have the most tracked time and the list of team projects (Website Relaunch, Interne Tools, Messe Frühjahr 2027, Kundenportal). Makes no changes.

negative.prompt: What is the weather in Berlin tomorrow?

negative.description: Data of other people or accounts outside the user's workspace
negative.prompt: Show me all tasks from my colleague's private Priomate account.
